LangGraph 1.2.24 synchronous subset.
StateGraph takes state_schema, input_schema, output_schema, context_schema.
add_node accepts a state callable, optionally taking runtime.
compile accepts checkpointer; invoke accepts input, config, context, durability, version.
invoke v1 returns output values; v2 returns GraphOutput with value.
get_state, get_state_history and update_state accept RunnableConfig.
update_state accepts values and as_node. get_graph supports draw_mermaid.
Declarations are in typings/langgraph/graph. Real-library graph tests exercise them.
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/blob/1.2.24/libs/langgraph/langgraph/graph/state.py
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/blob/1.2.24/libs/langgraph/langgraph/pregel/main.py
CompiledStateGraph.with_config(config: RunnableConfig | None) returns Self.
get_graph returns langchain_core.runnables.graph.Graph with typed nodes and Edge values.
The installed 1.2.24 with_config copies the graph with merged config; diagram tests exercise node/edge collapse.
